Under the Employment policy of Vanguard or any of its subsidiaries, relatives may not work in the same area of responsibility or within the same transactional audit trail. A relative is defined as aunt/uncle, child/stepchild, cousin, daughter-in-law/son-in-law, grandchild, grandparent, guardian, niece/nephew, parent-in-law, parent/stepparent, sister-in-law/brother-in-law, sister/brother, and spouse/domestic partner. To help us ensure compliance with this policy, do you have any relatives employed at Vanguard or any of its subsidiaries?

Are you a current or former Government Official? Definition of a “Government Official” is:Any officer or employee of a government or any department, agency or instrumentality of a government; Any officer or employee of a public international organization (e.g., Red Cross, United Nations Inter-American Development Bank, International Monetary Fund, or World Bank); Any individual acting in an official capacity on behalf of a government entity or agency or public international organization; or Any individual of a company owned or controlled by a government entity; or Any close family members (e.g., brother, sister, mother, father, husband, wife or child) of a government official; and Any former government officials that may maintain some quasi-government status or be able to assert influence over certain government processes and authorizations.
